description: This file implements a thread-safe, time-based storage buffer for container statistics, including methods for adding data, retrieving data within a time range, and managing buffer size and age constraints.

classes.name: TimedStore
classes.description: A time-based buffer for ContainerStats, supporting addition, retrieval, and eviction based on age and size constraints.

methods.name: NewTimedStore
methods.description: Creates a new thread-compatible TimedStore with specified age and maxItems limit.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the buffer, maintaining order and evicting old or excess data.

methods.name: InTimeRange
methods.description: Retrieves data within a specified time range, limited by maxResults.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the data at a specific index in LIFO order.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the buffer.
